pytoce_pellet_recovery.technology_boundary: Native PP, PS and rigid-PVC operations integrate sorting, washing, grinding and extrusion to deliver finished pellets.
pytoce_pellet_recovery.allocation_boundary: Use admitted native dry feed per reference output for operation demand. The material recipe sets recovered pellets and managed, air, and water exits. Retain native production, operating inputs and exchange metadata after removing the principal purchases and reject blocks. Freight is scaled by the actual pellets.
pytoce_pellet_recovery.geography_year_boundary: Explicit RER operation and product-market functions across the 12 world regions, with selected-anchor backgrounds. Fixed source retentions preserve their separate Dutch packaging and circa-2000 PVC pipe/fitting boundaries; same-portfolio recovered receiving functions remain declared transfers.
pytoce_pellet_recovery.limitation: PP, PS and PVC use the selected recovery inventories. Freight follows actual recovered-pellet mass. Native auxiliary and effluent inventories are retained; principal residues use the material-specific treatments.

pytoce_pet_recovery.technology_boundary: Shared PET sorting/washing preparation, followed by APR food-grade finishing for bottle PET and bio-PET, or generic PET pelletising for fibre PET. Complete flake and pellet delivery functions remain distinct.
pytoce_pet_recovery.allocation_boundary: Admitted preparation dry feed/reference ratio sets operating demand. Recovery independently sets pellets P; admitted PET finishing ratio g gives flakes F=g*P. Native operating production and retained metadata are unchanged. Principal purchases and replaced rejects are removed once; actual remainder treatment belongs to MFA/LCA material custody.
pytoce_pet_recovery.geography_year_boundary: RER operations and Dutch packaging recovery data apply to the selected PET constituents across the 12 world regions. The PET road/rail portfolio scales with actual flake and pellet mass; receiving conversion portfolios are retained.
pytoce_pet_recovery.limitation: Fiber PET uses the packaging-derived preparation function. Native wastewater, utility, auxiliary and waste-treatment inventories are retained.

pytoce_pet_food_grade_finish.technology_boundary: APR 2018 Table 2-4 whole food-grade finishing meters replace generic finisher electricity. Retain native finishing water, full wastewater, dust and equipment. Full native gas supply/firing and nitrogen supply/venting supply all five reported inputs.
pytoce_pet_food_grade_finish.allocation_boundary: The 0.48 kWh meter replaces direct finisher and furnace electricity once. Upstream electricity remains with its existing suppliers. Native NG and propane reference production is normalized to fuel input. LPG supplies its actual mass, fuel carbon, and declared sulfur; propane-furnace equipment and other emissions transfer on equal input energy using original fuel properties and dated fuel quantities.

services.name: Cooled PBS reactor product (fossil)

representative_method.functional_unit: 1 kg cooled PBS reactor product before finishing
representative_method.stoichiometric_basis: The reconstruction uses C4H6O4 + C4H10O2 -> C8H12O4 + 2 H2O, with 118.088, 90.122, 172.180 and 36.030 g/mol. The reported gross BDO charge determines internal recycle and net demand.
representative_method.bdo_recycle_authority: Ioannidou et al. Section 2.1.3.3 recycles unreacted BDO and recovers remaining BDO; the exact internal amount is the project stoichiometric reconciliation of the rounded Table SM5 charge, interpreted as gross feed for this reconstruction
representative_method.high_pressure_steam_boundary: excluded because Table SM5 footnotes assign it only to wheat-straw/first-generation monomer combinations; the selected monomer services supply monomer production
representative_method.backbone_normalization_equation: q = 1 / (1 + 0.002 * 0.6858404); cooled PBS reactor product = q * pure PBS backbone + q * 0.002 * 0.6858404 catalyst-derived residue. Proportional finishing retains this same composition per finished kg.
representative_method.catalyst_boundary: Catalyst-derived residue remains in the normalized reactor product and partitions proportionally between finished pellets and rejects.
representative_method.reaction_water_boundary: The separately reconstructed 0.2089711123374521 kg nominal H2O component receives the complete European hydraulic-water collection/plant once. Original process-water input 0.49 kg, cooling-water input 0.26 kg and internal recovered BDO remain separate. These quantities retain their separate process functions.

native_service_mapping.low_pressure_steam: The kilogram-based chemical-industry steam market supplies low-pressure steam demand.

representative_method.source_boundary_limitation: European collection and treatment receive reaction water. Catalyst-derived residue remains with the product; process and cooling-water inputs are recorded separately.
representative_method.native_utility_limitation: Chemical-industry steam, decarbonized cooling water, deionized process water and medium-voltage electricity supply utilities. Cooling-water demand follows the stated decarbonized-water supply.

reaction_water_receiving_reference.basis: The H2O component remains separate from recovered organics and other material outputs.
reaction_water_receiving_reference.volume_equation: Negative W / 1000 m3 per kg product, with W in kg H2O and the nominal water density 1000 kg/m3. Negative volume requests treatment from the native negative-production collection; normalize once at that owner.
reaction_water_receiving_reference.source_transfer: JRC Polymers BREF 2007 sections 6.2.5 and 12.5.3 support external polyester reaction-water receiving. Their unsaturated-polyester practice is transferred; Doka 2021 and the selected native European service supply the complete hydraulic/operational reference.
reaction_water_receiving_reference.burden_ownership: One collector includes sewer, plant handoff and bypass; its plant retains hydraulics, heat, capital, screenings and water fates.
reaction_water_receiving_reference.geography: Europe without Switzerland is a fixed qualified receiving proxy for the global resin reference; dated suppliers follow each background. The MFA tracks regional material quantities.

source_balance_outputs.disposition: Internal BDO recovery follows the stoichiometric reconstruction and returns to the reactor within the source process.
Reaction-water quantity follows the stoichiometric reconstruction; the separate collection and treatment function owns receiving.

product_associated_constituents.disposition: The full catalyst-derived residue remains within one kg cooled reactor product. Finishing scales the reactor purchase and partitions residue proportionally between pellets and rejects.

routes.selection_reason: Receive the original TPS formulation mass and its retained auxiliaries/water; apply the common burning share across the 12 world regions once outside the unit provider.
routes.limitation: The three historical TPS formulations use Doka uncontrolled-burning equations. Synthetic TPS contains about 3.8 mg chlorine per wet kg; the source halogen function uses that content. PCB and TCDD use the source atom references, with the tire particulate profile (Downard et al., 2015, via Doka, 2017) and organic-component gross heat. Fixed process-N2O nitrogen is assigned to atmospheric nitrogen, and thermal NOx follows the source. The inventory represents uncontrolled burning and the resulting on-site residues.

routes.limitation: Complete MIXED inventories supply TPS emissions, degradation and linked services. Formulation water, protein and reagents set wet mass. Direct waste gases are attributed by total formulation carbon, with principal and auxiliary origins kept separate. Municipal RoW and the common five-climate GLO dump portfolio apply across 12 world regions.
